attempt: Put the generated ZAS_ActivePack.zip in the world's mods directory without explicitly enabling its pack ID in save config.
reason_failed: Hytale skipped the present ZIP because config.json stored ZytaleGenerated:AdaptiveSurfaceWorld with Enabled=false. Plugin consequently loaded zero baked block sources and appearances, so placement retained fallback stone.
error_signature: Skipped disabled pack: ZytaleGenerated:AdaptiveSurfaceWorld; [ZAS] Loaded 0 baked block sources and 0 baked appearances
conditions: Save config Mods entry has Enabled=false
workaround: Installer stages the ZIP, backs up config.json and sets the exact generated pack ID Enabled=true before next world start.
